result:
The candidate passes every blocking check. One advisory: the suite has no test for the HTML-only body decision, so the verdict is FINDINGS rather than PASS.

- **A1:** both suites pass, and my mutations turned off each change item one at a time. The suite caught 18 of the 19.
- **A2:** on the full selftest against the extended fake, run 1 has 0 `write_rejected` and run 2 makes 0 writes. The base loader on the same fake reproduces the crm-dev failures, so the check can fail.
- **The gap:** if the recipient-less email Task gets a made-up description (`TextBody or "x"`), all 178 load tests still pass. The code itself does the right thing: my own scenario shows an HTML-only body gives a null description, and that scenario catches the mutant.
- **Fake setup:** A2 only reaches 0 `write_rejected` after running the real settings provisioning (GBP). The fake's default currency is USD, which refuses all 50 Opportunities. That matches what the PL did on crm-dev.
- **A3** is the PL's live run on crm-dev, so I did not test it.
